clauses.title: CL-D125 records that the packaged driver collects no separate enterprise policy
requires: The packaged driver collects no enterprise policy of its own.

The helper relies on GitHub's repository ruleset listing including the rulesets configured at higher levels that apply to the repository (its `includes_parents` default), so a ruleset that targets the repository from above appears in that listing and is evaluated like every other one.
The driver's `writability` call passes `enterprisePolicyComplete: true, enterpriseRulesets: []`, which asserts that nothing applies beyond the repository and organization listings the helper reads.
A listing or ruleset detail the actor cannot read stops collection, and the driver ends `BLOCKED` before any gate runs.

clauses.title: The driver passes the enterprise policy proof as a constant beside its one writability call
requires: run.op('writability', { owner, repo, branchRef: `refs/heads/${target.headBranch}`, cwd: checkout, enterprisePolicyComplete: true, enterpriseRulesets: [] });
